head: 40d5f29
working_tree: runs 'after' and 'after2' were built from an export of step-4 commit 2 as first reviewed (wip dd2c267; its TUI, attachment client, mock, observer and dev files are hashed under reviewed_files_sha256). Run 'after3' was built from an export of the first fixed tree (c2b, wip 84e4cf3). Run 'after4' was built from an export of the second fixed tree (c2c), whose files are identical to 40d5f29 apart from this evidence (final_files_sha256); it differs from c2b only in internal/tui/model.go (Enter on an O row clears the session last acted on) and model_test.go. The fix changed internal/tui/view.go (a start or stop of the page's session reads as its readiness), internal/tui/workflows.go (followOperation(op, requested): an operation read with operation.inspect is only observed), the mock (it keeps only a session's newest start or stop) and model_test.go; GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
scope: Production p tui against the disposable mock socket (dev/tui-mock --dataset small --theme dark, run through tests/integration/tui-observe.py): Enter on a stopped and on a ready session, entry into the mock terminal and Ctrl-B d; s, y (Stop) on a running and on a stopped session; Back during a slowed start and a slowed stop; start and stop answered by errors; O and Enter on a completed start and stop. mock.configure slowed session.start, session.stop, session.inspect and session.attach by up to 5 s, one call per configure, and answered failed/runtime and retry/session_held. The mock's start and stop operations complete at once, so no start or stop was ever running or failed: the operation.wait follow, the page of a running or failed start, a failed start's reason sentence and diagnostic, and the stopping condition were not reachable. No Incus, Git or real-daemon claim
prototype: proto run: .prototype/tui-options/.cache/bin/p-sessions (selected browser) at 120x35. Enter on a stopped session shows 'STARTING SESSION (atlas / fix/tile-seams)' with a boot log and 'q | Esc | Ctrl-C back · startup continues', then enters the terminal (proto-0015..0017). s opens 'Stop session? atlas / fix/tile-seams ... [y/N]'; y shows 'STOPPING CONTAINER atlas / fix/tile-seams' with a shutdown log and returns to the picker (proto-0020, proto-0021). s on a stopped session answers 'Session is already stopped.' on the picker without a confirmation (proto-0023). The product's progress page, its 'Stopped.' page and its confirmation of an already stopped session predate this change
before: export of a3e7d6d (step-4 commit 1, already reviewed in operation-wait): session.start and session.stop answer the session; Enter starts and attaches once the answer reads ready; the progress page polls session.inspect on the tick for a starting session

runs.proto: prototype baseline at 120x35: Enter on a stopped session, entry, Ctrl-B d; s, y; s on a stopped session
runs.before: 120x35: s, y on forge / fix/token-refresh with stop slowed, Stopped, Back; s, y again on the stopped session; Enter with start slowed and session.attach slowed (handoff frame), entry, a command, Ctrl-B d; Enter on the ready forge / feat/device-login, Ctrl-B d; s, y on orbit / feat/job-retries with stop slowed and Esc during it; Enter with start slowed and q during it; stop answered retry/session_held, y again; start answered failed/runtime at 120x35, 80x24 and 48x16; at 48x16 and 80x24 a slowed start to entry and a slowed stop to Stopped

Two q from that page left the TUI (Back from an operation opened in O returns to sessions, as before), which ended the run and its mock at frame 0040

calls_before: Enter on a stopped session: session.start, then session.attach from p attach; on a ready session: the same; s, y: session.stop; Back during a start or stop: nothing after the answer
calls_after: Enter on a stopped session: session.start (completed operation), session.inspect, then session.start (changed:false) and session.attach from p attach; on a ready session: session.start (changed:false) and p attach's session.start and session.attach, no session.inspect; s, y: session.stop only (its operation completed, so no operation.wait); s, y on a stopped session: session.stop only (changed:false); Back during a start: no session.inspect or session.attach after the answer (after-0035); Back during a stop: nothing after; r on the recorded Stop page: operation.retry and one operation.wait {timeout: 20}
matched_frames: apart from session names and IDs, the text is identical before and after for: the Stop confirmation and its waiting line, the Stopped page of an already stopped session, the start waiting page at 120x35, 80x24 and 48x16, the handoff page ('Condition: ready' with the waiting line; after2-0016 and before-0012, also identical in color and cursor), entry and detach, Enter on a ready session (entered within 0.3 s), Back during a start or stop, and the start and stop error pages at every size. The Stopped page after a recorded stop changed (finding S1)
component_tests: go test -count=1 ./internal/tui/... ./tests/integration/cmd/tui-mock/... ./internal/errtext/... ./internal/attachment/... passed on the after tree (internal/attachment needs a short TMPDIR, as just unit-tests sets). TestStartAndStopFollowTheirOperations covers a running start followed by operation.wait and then session.inspect, a running stop followed to 'Stopped. Files and branch retained.', and an already stopped session reporting it at once. No component test renders the page of a running or failed start, or a stopping row. On the fixed tree the same packages passed again; TestStartAndStopFollowTheirOperations now also checks that the Stop page reads as the session's readiness ('a / feature', 'Condition: stopped') and that a completed stop read with operation.inspect does not report Stopped. On the second fixed tree the same packages passed again; TestStartAndStopFollowTheirOperations also checks that a start or stop opened from O uses the operation layout
tui_tests: just tui-tests on the after tree: 8 terminal, 9 observer and 12 mock tests OK (24 s); on the fixed tree 8 terminal, 9 observer and 12 mock tests OK again (the mock tests took 23 s); on the second fixed tree 8 terminal, 9 observer and 12 mock tests OK again (the mock tests took 22 s)
stopping: not rendered: the mock's sessions are only ready or stopped, its start and stop complete at once, and no mock.configure fault sets a condition. By reading view.go, a stopping row is drawn like starting: the list's runtime column shows 'stopping' in the warning color (unchanged code path), and Details' 'Runtime: stopping' and the compact 48-column line now color it too (the change adds 'stopping' to factLine). d/X on a stopping session answers 'Removal is unavailable while the session is stopping.'
not_reached: a running start or stop: by reading, its page would use the operation layout ('session.start · running / starting', Operation, Key, Session UUID, 'Retry resumes exact captured intent…') without the project/branch line or 'Leaving startup prevents automatic entry when it finishes.' while the wait runs; Back still prevents entry. A failed start: its reason sentence and diagnostic. The tick no longer reading session.inspect for a starting session: before never reached that poll in the mock either, because start answered ready

findings.S1: resolved by the fix. Seen on the reviewed tree: open (new, low): after a Stop that records an operation the page switches to the operation layout. It names the session only by UUID, drops 'forge / fix/token-refresh' and 'Condition: stopped', shows a Key equal to the Operation ID, and adds 'Retry resumes exact captured intent; changed inputs need a new request.', which does not apply to a completed Stop (after-0006, after2-0007, after2-0008). Before, the page kept the session layout (before-0006, before-0048, before-0047). Stopping an already stopped session still shows the session layout (after-0010), so the same 'Stopped. Files and branch retained.' appears on two different pages. The before page's 'Leaving startup prevents automatic entry when it finishes.' no longer shows after a recorded stop. On the fixed tree the recorded Stop page reads 'forge / fix/token-refresh', 'Session: <uuid>', 'Condition: stopped', 'Leaving startup prevents automatic entry when it finishes.' and 'Stopped. Files and branch retained.' at 120x35 (after3-0006), 80x24 (after3-0007) and 48x16 (after3-0008), as before-0006/0048/0047 did, with one empty row fewer (no empty Diagnostic line), so at 48x16 the whole 'Leaving startup…' sentence now fits. A recorded Stop and an already stopped session now show the same page (after3-0031, after3-0042). The start waiting page is unchanged (after3-0011, after3-0012) and entry still follows (after3-0013). On the second fixed tree the recorded Stop page reads the same as on the first (after4-0006, identical text to after3-0006)
findings.S2: open (pre-existing, low): s on a stopped session asks for confirmation and then reports 'Stopped. Files and branch retained.' as if it had stopped it (before-0009, after-0010); the prototype answers 'Session is already stopped.' without a confirmation (proto-0023). The API's changed:false now tells the two cases apart; the TUI does not use it Resolved 2026-11-03 in the TUI fixes review (tui-fixes/checkpoint.json): s on a stopped session answers 'Session is already stopped.' without a confirmation, as the prototype does, and a stop answered changed:false says the same (tui-fixes after-0018, after-0020)
findings.S3: resolved by the fix. Seen on the reviewed tree: open (new, low): opening a completed session.stop from O runs the Stop completion. It shows 'Stopped. Files and branch retained.' and records the session as just used, which moves it among same-priority sessions of its project. In the mock the stop opened predated a later start, so the page said Stopped while the session ran (after-0038). The daemon deletes a session's earlier finished start or stop when it records the next, so there the only one listed is the latest and the notice matches; the reordering remains. A completed session.start opened from O reads 'Operation completed. Back returns to sessions.' (after2-0040). On the fixed tree a completed stop opened from O reads 'Operation completed. Back returns to sessions.' instead of 'Stopped.' (after3-0034), and is no longer recorded as an interaction (by reading: followOperation's stop branch runs only for a requested operation)
findings.S4: resolved by the fix. Seen on the reviewed tree: open (new, low, mock fidelity): the mock keeps every start and stop operation; O grew to seven rows, five of them start/stop of one session, and the blocked rename moved from first to third (after-0036, after2-0039). The daemon keeps at most one finished start or stop per session. The rows read 'forge · session.stop · completed / complete' without a branch, so rows of two forge sessions cannot be told apart (pre-existing row format, now with more rows). On the fixed tree, after three starts and four stops of two sessions, O lists three rows: orbit's latest stop, the blocked rename and forge's latest start (after3-0033). The rows still name no branch (pre-existing row format)
findings.S5: open (pre-existing, low, newly reachable): p attach now starts the session itself. When its start answers an error after the TUI's own start and read succeeded, it prints 'p: The runtime failed; check Incus and try again.' on the last row, the TUI's redraw erases it at once, and the page shows only 'Attachment ended: exit status 1' (after2-0046). This is the open error-sentences finding about TUI attach failures; before, only session.attach could fail there Resolved 2026-11-03 in the TUI fixes review (tui-fixes/checkpoint.json): the TUI shows p attach's own sentence: 'Attachment ended: The runtime failed; check Incus and try again.' (tui-fixes after-0023)
findings.W2: still open (pre-existing): at 48x16 the waiting line is clipped to 'Waiting for daemon… (Back leaves accepted work …' and the start page's 'Leaving startup prevents automatic entry when it finishes.' is cut after 'entry' by the page's row capacity (before-0041, after2-0034, before-0039, after2-0012) Resolved 2026-11-03 in the TUI fixes review (tui-fixes/checkpoint.json): the waiting line wraps at 48x16, and the start page shows 'Leaving startup prevents automatic entry when it finishes.' whole above it (tui-fixes after3-0008; the Stop confirmation's waiting line, after3-0005)
findings.O3: still open (pre-existing layout): at 48x16 the recorded Stop page shows 'Stopped.' but 'Leaving this screen does not cancel an accepted operation.' and the Retry line are below the fold (after2-0008, after2-0032) Resolved 2026-11-03 in the TUI fixes review (tui-fixes/checkpoint.json): see operation-reasons O3
findings.O4: still open (pre-existing key hint): 'r retry operation' is offered on every progress page, including the start, start-error and already-stopped pages, where r does nothing. On the recorded Stop page r now sends operation.retry for the completed stop; the mock answered it completed and the page reported Stopped again (after-0007). The daemon answers a completed operation unchanged Resolved 2026-11-03 in the TUI fixes review (tui-fixes/checkpoint.json): the recorded Stop page offers only q/Esc back and r sends nothing (tui-fixes after-0015)
findings.S6: resolved by the second fix. Seen on the first fixed tree: from O, a completed start or stop of the session the TUI last acted on reads as that session's readiness: 'orbit / feat/job-retries', 'Condition: stopped' and 'Leaving startup prevents automatic entry when it finishes.', with no kind, operation ID or status, although nothing is starting (after3-0034). The completed start of another session opened the same way keeps the operation layout with 'session.start · completed / complete' and its ID (after3-0039). Which layout a row opens in depends on the last session acted on, which the O page does not show. On the second fixed tree, Enter on an O row clears the session last acted on: orbit's completed stop, opened right after stopping orbit, reads 'session.stop · completed / complete' with its Operation, Key and Session lines and 'Operation completed. Back returns to sessions.' (after4-0017), as forge's completed start does (after4-0022). Back returns to sessions, and s on the selected session still names it in the confirmation (after4-0024)

improvement: none visible in the mock. Each start and stop is now an operation the user can find in O, and Back during a slowed start or stop leaves the session list without entry or further reads, as before
calls_fixed: mock.inspect after 'after3': each Stop issued one session.stop and nothing more; Enter on the stopped session issued session.start, session.inspect, then p attach's session.start and session.attach; each O row opened issued one operation.inspect and no operation.wait; s, y on the stopped session issued one session.stop (changed:false). After 'after4': the recorded Stop issued one session.stop; each O row opened issued one operation.inspect and nothing more
